correctness.rationale: The monomial ratio is derived by exact integration and strictly decreasing. A unique one-dimensional saddle yields log lambda_k=−kappa sqrt(k)+c+O(k^{−1/2}) uniformly for fixed parameters. Monotonicity localizes the degree cutoff to O(1) around ((L+c)/kappa)^2. Exact homogeneous polynomial multiplicities give the two-term logarithmic count; jump sizes yield the sharp error-order lower bound. Tonelli and exact Laplace gamma integrals prove the two-term small-p trace. The independent quadrature checker reproduces 96 finite diagnostics in four cases, not an infinite proof.
